stories.title: France blocks under 15 social media ban
stories.summary: France’s Constitutional Council has blocked a bill that would have banned social media access for under-15s, ruling that it infringed on freedom of expression. It’s a setback for President Emmanuel Macron, who has championed the legislation and has now asked his prime minister to rewrite the bill. The Élysée says Macron remains determined to have the reform in place before next year’s presidential election. France 24 International Affairs editor tells us more.

stories.title: RTS Index down below 800 points first since July
stories.summary: The Bank of Russia raised the dollar exchange rate to 84.54 rubles and the euro rate to 97.51 rubles
article_sentences: The dollar-denominated RTS Index has fallen below 800 points for the first time since July 20, 2026, after the publication of exchange rates by the Bank of Russia for August 15-17, according to the Moscow Exchange trading data.
The regulator raised the dollar exchange rate to 84.54 rubles and the euro rate to 97.51 rubles.
As of 5:29 p.m. Moscow time (2:29 p.m. GMT), the RTS was down by 4.8% at 798.75 points.
As of 5:34 p.m. Moscow time (2:34 p.m. GMT), the RTS was down by 4.89% at 798.06 points, while the MOEX Index was down by 4.05% at 2,141.83 points.
